scope: Fixed W1 actor, frozen C1 critic, strict label randomization; native RECAP-style adaptation, development only
shuffle_gate: At least 10 eligible scheduled draws change labels; original rewards/outcomes/MC targets unchanged
success_matched: Same all-data draw schedule; fixed positive masks on successful observations matching actual retained samples per task. Outcome composition intentionally differs, physical-action counts reported.
reward: Binary terminal success, gamma1, no clock; C1 fitted on older pool, reused without tuning
threshold: Unweighted global train-decision advantage quantile0.7, no validation tuning
evaluation: Fixed final128 only, original24 development scenes, maximum96 new rollouts; W1 reference reused with observed-init check
selection: No checkpoint/seed/threshold search; gate exposure audit before any actor training
